title: The Third Turn
lines: Meg and Kurt run on the dirt path.
Meg gets the first turn on the sled.
Then Kurt gets his turn on it.
He bumps a rock and lands in dirt.
His shirt gets dirt all on it.
He curls up for a bit.
Meg helps him up with her hand.
Kurt grins and gets a third turn.

questions.ask: Who got the first turn on the sled?
questions.listenFor: Meg. Kurt had to stand and wait his turn.
He bumped a rock, landed in the dirt, and curled up for a bit. Listen for the rock.

questions.ask: Do you think Kurt was brave to go again? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. Listen for a reason, like he grinned and took a third turn.
